messages:
From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Maria Lopez <maria.lopez@helixbank.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-01-20T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Private deployment CAIQ package & KMS rotation logs request

Hi Maria —

Thanks again for the conversation yesterday. Per your compliance team's ask, we want to assemble a compact CAIQ response package scoped to HelixBank's private deployment signing. To keep this tight and auditable, can you confirm two scope points before we pull artifacts:

1) Confirmed runtime footprint: is the evaluation limited to the VPC-hosted private control plane + on-prem data plane (no multi-tenant hosted endpoints)?
2) KMS ownership model: will HelixBank manage keys (customer-managed keys via your KMS/HSM) or do you want Redwood to provide key rotation evidence for our tenant-side stub keys?

Once you confirm, we'll export the CAIQ control assertions that map to the private deployment surface and attach: a) a scope matrix, b) sample KMS rotation logs (redacted), and c) the tenant isolation network diagram.

Deliverables we plan to attach in the first pass: redwood-private-scope-matrix.xlsx, kms-rotation-log-sample.zip (redacted entries), tenant-isolation-diagram.pdf. If your team needs live proofs (live rotation API traces or HSM attestations), tell us what window you want sampled (e.g., last 90 days).

Timeline: we can get the first package to you by EOD tomorrow if scope is locked this morning.

Thanks,
Mateo Alvarez
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

---
Attachment stubs referenced: redwood-private-scope-matrix.xlsx (spreadsheet), kms-rotation-log-sample.zip (logs .zip), tenant-isolation-diagram.pdf (pdf)

From: Maria Lopez <maria.lopez@helixbank.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-01-20T10:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Private deployment CAIQ package & KMS rotation logs request

Mateo —

Thanks for the rapid follow-up. Quick answers:

1) Scope: yes — private control plane in our VPC + on-prem data plane for inference nodes (we explicitly exclude Redwood hosted public API endpoints).
2) KMS: we will manage the customer keys in our HSM. We still need to see your end-of-run signing/key-wrapping evidence for the agent that handles ephemeral tokens; specifically we want rotation metadata for any Redwood-managed intermediate keys used in the deployment (if present).

Please include rotation metadata for any intermediate keys and a description of the key hierarchy. For sampling, last 60 days is sufficient. We prefer CSV extracts for rotation events.

Also, can you include a short narrative mapping for CAIQ controls that are affected by enclave/air-gapped nodes? Our security reviewer flagged questions around CSA CCM subcontrols: SA-9 (data segregation) and SEF-01 (runtime attestation).

Maria Lopez
Director, Information Security — HelixBank
security@helixbank.com

Good catch on the intermediate key request. Action items: 

- Mateo: assemble the scope matrix and the CAIQ assertion mapping doc that highlights SA-9 and the runtime attestation notes. Keep narratives short — 3–4 bullets per control linking to artifacts.
- David: pull the KMS rotation CSV for the last 60 days for the intermediate key ring used by the on-prem agent (redact key material). Include rotation event fields: timestamp, key_id (hashed), rotation_type, actor (service-account), request_id. Put in kms-rotation-log-sample.zip.

We should minimize PII in the logs; use hashed identifiers and a single sample trace (no more than 10 events) in the initial package. If Helix needs full traceability we can open an evidence window and schedule a live session.

I'll own sending the packaged bundle to Maria once we have the three artifacts. Target: 14:00 PST.
